subject: Usage Insights docs — IA, screenshots, and publish checklist
body:
From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
To: Wei Chen <wei.chen@redwoodinference.com>, Paula Mendes <paula.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Feb 10, 2026 at 9:14 AM PST
Subject: Usage Insights docs — IA, screenshots, and publish checklist

Team — aiming to publish the first pass of Usage Insights docs in time for the beta expansion next week.

1) Docs IA proposal (need a 👍/👎 today)
I propose we place it under:
Docs → Console → Usage & Billing → “Usage insights (cost drivers by route)”

Rationale:
- It’s primarily a console workflow + export, not SDK-only.
- FinOps / ops folks will look under billing/usage.
- Keeps “routing / route identifiers” content as a short subsection linking to SDK pages.

Pages planned (2 docs pages + 1 reference):
A) Overview: What Usage Insights is + key concepts (route, model, cached tokens) + limitations.
B) How-to: Tag routes + read route/model breakdown + export CSV/JSON.
C) Reference: Export schema (field definitions, limits, audit logging behavior).

2) Screenshots needed (blocking)
We need updated screenshots from staging for:
- Route list view (Top cost drivers) with filters open
- Route detail view with model breakdown
- Export modal + “Export started” toast
- (Optional) Audit log entry view showing export event, if accessible in console

Constraints for screenshots:
- No customer/org names (use internal sandbox org)
- Time range: last 7 days
- Show at least 3 routes; include an “Unknown route” row if that’s still in the UI (FAQ references it)

3) Final publish checklist
- Confirm naming: “Usage insights” vs “Usage Insights” (H1 capitalization)
- Confirm route naming conventions + cardinality warnings are accurate
- Confirm export limits (max rows/time range) and error messaging

Can we confirm IA today and get screenshots by EOD Wed?

—
Elliot Price
Docs Lead, Redwood Inference



From: Paula Mendes <paula.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>, Wei Chen <wei.chen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Feb 10, 2026 at 9:47 AM PST
Subject: Re: Usage Insights docs — IA, screenshots, and publish checklist

+1 on IA location under Console → Usage & Billing.

Two tweaks:
- Please call out “Available after Feb XX for orgs enrolled in beta / feature flag” (so we don’t get support tickets from customers who don’t see it).
- In the limitations section, include the freshness note (near-real-time, but metering can arrive late) + a single line about invoice reconciliation. Support asked us to set expectations early.

I’ll sync with Dylan/Felix re: screenshots.

Paula



From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Paula Mendes <paula.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Wei Chen <wei.chen@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Feb 10, 2026 at 10:18 AM PST
Subject: Re: Usage Insights docs — IA, screenshots, and publish checklist

IA looks good.

Screenshot notes from design:
- Route list: please capture the table with the “Spend” column, a sparkline, and the filter bar visible. If there’s a compare-to-prior-period toggle, include it.
- Route detail: show the model breakdown component + the “What changed” delta panel (even if numbers are fake). That panel is what we’ll get questions about.
- Export: show the export format selector (CSV/JSON) and the “bounded report” language.

Re: redaction: using the internal sandbox org is fine; avoid any GPU type strings that look like a specific customer contract (e.g., “Dedicated A100 pool — ACME”).

Thanks!
Tessa



From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
To: Felix Schneider <felix.schneider@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Paula Mendes <paula.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Wei Chen <wei.chen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Feb 10, 2026 at 11:06 AM PST
Subject: Screenshot request for Usage Insights docs (staging, by Wed)

Looping you in (Paula mentioned you could help).

We’re publishing docs for “Usage insights (cost drivers by route)” and need updated console screenshots from staging.

Shot list (minimum):
1) Route list view
- show 3+ routes
- show spend ranking + sparkline
- filters visible (time range, env, region if present)
- if there’s an “Unknown route” entry, include it in the table (docs FAQ references it)

2) Route detail view
- show model breakdown table/chart
- include the “What changed” / delta vs prior period panel

3) Export flow
- export modal with format selector (CSV + JSON)
- show the “bounded report” / limits language if visible
- capture the “export created” confirmation state/toast

Optional but nice:
4) Audit log view for export
- any screenshot that proves exports are audit-logged would help the security FAQ.

Redaction rules:
- use internal sandbox org only (no customer logos/names)
- no personally identifying route names (e.g., don’t use a route with an email in it)

Timing: could we get these by EOD Wed (2/11)? If not, please reply with ETA so we can adjust publish date.

Thank you.

—
Elliot



From: Felix Schneider <felix.schneider@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Paula Mendes <paula.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Wei Chen <wei.chen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Feb 11, 2026 at 3:32 PM PST
Subject: Re: Screenshot request for Usage Insights docs (staging, by Wed)

Yep — I can grab these.

A couple questions before I take them so we don’t iterate:
1) Any preference on light/dark mode? Staging defaults to dark for my account.
2) For the “Unknown route” row: in current build, it shows up if the request has no route tag OR the tag fails normalization (too long). I can force it either way.
3) Audit log: we have the export audit event in the org audit log page, but it’s behind an internal-only permission. I can grab it from our sandbox org if that’s acceptable.

ETA: I’ll send a folder of PNGs by tomorrow morning (Thu) if that’s okay. Today EOD is tight because I need to seed data for the “What changed” panel to look non-empty.

Also, for the screenshots I’ll use:
- org: “Redwood Sandbox – Console”
- project: “usage-insights-docs”
- routes: /chat/completions, /embeddings, /rerank

Felix



From: Wei Chen <wei.chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Paula Mendes <paula.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Feb 12, 2026 at 9:08 AM PST
Subject: Re: Usage Insights docs — IA, screenshots, and publish checklist

I’m aligned on IA.

Content checklist items I think we should not ship without (quick bullets):
- Clear definition of “route”: developer-supplied route id vs gateway-derived fallback; note it’s not necessarily the URL path.
- Naming conventions + cardinality warnings (no user IDs / no per-tenant route strings). Mention max length + allowed characters at a high level.
- Explain cached tokens vs input/output tokens (especially for finance readers). Monica said this is a recurring confusion.
- Export notes:
  - max time range (whatever we’re shipping)
  - what’s included (filters) and what’s NOT included (raw prompts/completions)
  - audit logging: “export created” + “downloaded” events (if that’s accurate)

If you want, I can do a final pass on the “route tagging” section today and make sure it doesn’t drift from the SDK header names.

Wei



From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
To: Wei Chen <wei.chen@redwoodinference.com>, Felix Schneider <felix.schneider@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Paula Mendes <paula.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Feb 12, 2026 at 4:48 PM PST
Subject: Re: Usage Insights docs — IA, screenshots, and publish checklist

Thanks all — locking plan.

Decisions (final):
- IA: Docs → Console → Usage & Billing → Usage insights (cost drivers by route)
- Naming: “Usage insights” (sentence case in nav), “Usage Insights” in prose okay, H1 will be “Usage insights” to match nav.

Felix:
- Dark mode is fine (consistent with most console screenshots on site). If it hurts readability we’ll re-capture, but I’d rather not block.
- Please force an “Unknown route” row via missing route tag (not normalization failure). We’ll mention normalization separately and don’t want the screenshot to imply it’s the common cause.
- Audit log screenshot from sandbox org is perfect — we’ll add it to the security FAQ.
- Thu morning ETA works; we’ll hold publish until screenshots are in.

Wei:
- Yes please do a pass on route tagging section today. Focus on:
  - the header/param name used across SDKs
  - one short code snippet per language (TS + Python only in v1; we can add Go later)
  - keep it “how to set the route id” and avoid framework-specific rabbit holes

Publish checklist (what I’m holding before I hit merge on docs PRs):
- [ ] Staging screenshots (route list, route detail, export modal + confirmation, optional audit log)
- [ ] Beta gating note + feature availability disclaimer
- [ ] Freshness + invoice reconciliation FAQ (one paragraph, not a wall of text)
- [ ] Export schema page matches actual CSV/JSON field names + limits
- [ ] Monica confirms the cached tokens explanation reads correctly for finance

Attaching the checklist PDF + shotlist for convenience.

—
Elliot Price
Docs Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- Usage-Insights-Docs-Publish-Checklist.pdf
- usage-insights-screenshot-shotlist-v3.txt
